name: Apps for AI camera glasses
title: Apps for AI camera glasses: big enough, but who owns the channel?
question: Is building apps for AI camera glasses ripe now?
answer: Camera glasses failed as a product for a decade; then EssilorLuxottica sold 7 million Meta glasses in 2025 alone. About 10 million units a year is roughly where third-party app ecosystems have appeared before, so the install base is close. The open check is the TiVo and Apollo trap: the platform owner controls the app channel and can take any category an app proves.
verdict_reason: The install base is growing fast; platform-owner capture is the unpriced risk.

constraint.name: Install base, and access to it
constraint.detail: An app layer needs enough devices and an open channel to them; the platform owner decides the second.
